about_the_game:
"Brothers of The Three Kingdoms" is a top-down action roguelike where players take on the role of legendary warriors from the Three Kingdoms era (such as Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, or Zhao Yun), wielding multiple weapons and skills simultaneously to fend off waves of relentless enemies.

Each run allows you to customize your hero by combining randomly generated traits, weapons, and items to create unique combat builds. Will you dominate the battlefield with Zhang Fei’s brutal twin halberds, or weave through enemies with Zhao Yun’s agile spear techniques? Different loadouts deliver entirely distinct playstyles!

Survive against the clock as enemy forces grow ever stronger. Your arsenal and abilities evolve with each battle—but can you hold out until reinforcements arrive and cement your legacy as an unstoppable warlord?
